description: This file defines a header for utility functions related to searching for RDK profiles in device properties. It includes macros, an enum for profile types, and a function to read and parse the device properties file to determine the profile type.

methods.name: searchRdkProfile
methods.description: Reads the device properties file to find the RDK_PROFILE setting and returns the corresponding profile type (TV, STB, or NOT_FOUND).
